She has been expire before 10Years ago. Question: I want go tour for umra may i can do by my late fathers sister.Is it right according to kuran. She has been expire before 10Years ago. Answer ID: 20700 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 483/403/B=1431) Yes, you can perform Umrah on behalf of the late sister of your father. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
